Target company: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple MixC Hefei opens for customers this Saturday, January 18, in Anhui, China.

Decision cutoff: 2025-01-15T23:59:59-05:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Apple MixC Hefei opens for customers this Saturday, January 18, in Anhui, China. Published date: 2025-01-15. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/01/apple-mixc-hefei-opens-for-customers-this-saturday-january-18-in-anhui-china.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: HEFEI, CHINA Apple today previewed Apple MixC Hefei, the first store in the dynamic city and the first in China’s Anhui province. “We are so thrilled to open Apple MixC Hefei, our first store in the Anhui province, and build deeper connections with our customers in China,” said Deirdre O’Brien, Apple’s senior vice president of Retail and People. Apple MixC Hefei is home to over 80 team members ready to offer customers personalized service and support. Configure-to-order options are available, allowing Mac customers to select and customize devices to their specifications, including the new 24-inch iMac, Mac mini, and MacBook Pro, all powered by the advanced M4 family of chips. Apple MixC Hefei will officially open its doors to the public on Saturday, January 18, at 10 a.m. local time.
